{{CSGO}}: 2018-10-08 }} '''Team Vitality''' is a [[:Category:France|French]] professional esports organization which entered ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' in early October 2018. They are commonly regarded as one of the most successful organizations in ''CS'' history, having won over 20 S-tier trophies, including three [[Majors]], and being the only organization to win two consecutive [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slams]].
